callees.name: _strip_angle_brackets
callees.pre_condition: text is a string that may contain angle-bracket-delimited regions such as template or generic parameter lists.
callees.post_condition: Returns text with each outermost balanced '<...>' region removed: both the delimiting angle brackets and all content between them are stripped. Nesting is resolved — a '<' encountered between an outer '<' and its matching '>' belongs to the inner region and does not terminate the outer region. All characters outside any balanced '<...>' region are preserved in their original relative order.
